heading.en: The Mexican wave in a stadium

hook.en: At a cricket match in Chinnaswamy stadium a wave runs round the stands, yet every fan only stands up and sits down in their own seat. Something travels, but the people do not.
hook.kn: ಚಿನ್ನಸ್ವಾಮಿ ಕ್ರೀಡಾಂಗಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರೇಕ್ಷಕರ ಅಲೆ ಸುತ್ತ ಓಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರೂ ತಮ್ಮ ಆಸನದಲ್ಲೇ ಎದ್ದು ಕುಳಿತುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಏನೋ ಸಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಜನರಲ್ಲ.

objectives.en: Explain that a wave carries energy, not matter
Say which media carry which waves

narration.en: At a cricket match in Chinnaswamy stadium a wave runs round the stands, yet every fan only stands up and sits down in their own seat. Something travels, but the people do not.
narration.kn: ಚಿನ್ನಸ್ವಾಮಿ ಕ್ರೀಡಾಂಗಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರೇಕ್ಷಕರ ಅಲೆ ಸುತ್ತ ಓಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬರೂ ತಮ್ಮ ಆಸನದಲ್ಲೇ ಎದ್ದು ಕುಳಿತುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಏನೋ ಸಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಜನರಲ್ಲ.

body.en: A mechanical wave is a disturbance that travels through a medium because each part of the medium is linked to its neighbours by elastic forces. The particles only oscillate about their mean positions; the wave carries energy and the pattern of the disturbance, not the matter itself. Mechanical waves need a medium; electromagnetic waves do not.
body.kn: ಯಾಂತ್ರಿಕ ತರಂಗ ಮಾಧ್ಯಮದ ಮೂಲಕ ಸಾಗುವ ಕ್ಷೋಭೆ. ಕಣಗಳು ತಮ್ಮ ಸ್ಥಾನದ ಸುತ್ತ ಆಂದೋಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ ಮಾತ್ರ; ತರಂಗವು ಶಕ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಒಯ್ಯುತ್ತದೆ, ದ್ರವ್ಯವನ್ನಲ್ಲ.

say.en: Shake one end of a stretched string. A transverse wave runs along it: crests and troughs.
Each bit of string only moves up and down, at right angles to the direction of travel. The wave carries energy, not the string.
Push and pull a long spring. Coils crowd into compressions and spread into rarefactions. The coils move along the direction of travel: a longitudinal wave.
Sound in air is longitudinal. A string carries transverse waves. Solids can carry both; gases and liquids only longitudinal ones.

narration.en: Shake one end of a stretched string. A transverse wave runs along it: crests and troughs. Each bit of string only moves up and down, at right angles to the direction of travel. The wave carries energy, not the string. Push and pull a long spring. Coils crowd into compressions and spread into rarefactions. The coils move along the direction of travel: a longitudinal wave. Sound in air is longitudinal. A string carries transverse waves. Solids can carry both; gases and liquids only longitudinal ones.

body.en: In a transverse wave the particles oscillate perpendicular to the direction of travel, as on a stretched string; it forms crests and troughs. In a longitudinal wave they oscillate along the direction of travel, as in sound in air; it forms compressions and rarefactions. Transverse mechanical waves need a medium that resists change of shape (shear), so they travel in solids and along strings but not inside fluids. Longitudinal waves travel in solids, liquids and gases.
body.kn: ಅಡ್ಡ ತರಂಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಣಗಳು ಸಾಗುವ ದಿಕ್ಕಿಗೆ ಲಂಬವಾಗಿ ಆಂದೋಲಿಸುತ್ತವೆ: ಶೃಂಗ ಮತ್ತು ದ್ರೋಣಿ. ನೀಳ ತರಂಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಗುವ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲೇ: ಸಂಪೀಡನ ಮತ್ತು ವಿರಳನ. ದ್ರವಗಳ ಒಳಗೆ ಅಡ್ಡ ತರಂಗಗಳು ಸಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

points.en: Transverse: crests and troughs; solids and strings
Longitudinal: compressions and rarefactions; all media

points.en: A wave carries energy, not matter.
Transverse: perpendicular oscillation; crests and troughs.

homework.en: Classify as transverse or longitudinal: ripples on a pond, sound in water, a wave on a sitar string, a pulse on a slinky pushed along its length.

narration.en: Recap. A wave carries energy, not matter. Transverse: perpendicular oscillation; crests and troughs. Longitudinal: parallel oscillation; compressions and rarefactions. Fluids carry only longitudinal mechanical waves.
